definitions.gloss: receiver; receiving device (for radio, television, or other signals)
definitions.explanation: An electronic device that receives and decodes transmitted signals — radio, television, telemetry, satellite, GPS, or other wireless communication. A technical but widely understood word, common in user manuals, news about broadcasting, and explanations of wireless technology.

examples.japanese: ラジオの{受信機|じゅしんき}を{買|か}った。
この{受信機|じゅしんき}は{海外|かいがい}の{放送|ほうそう}も{受信|じゅしん}できる。
examples.english: This receiver can pick up overseas broadcasts.

examples.japanese: {衛星|えいせい}からの{信号|しんごう}を{正確|せいかく}にとらえるためには、{高性能|こうせいのう}の{受信機|じゅしんき}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: To accurately capture signals from satellites, a high-performance receiver is needed.

notes:
Compound of {受信|じゅしん} (receiving a signal) and the suffix {〜機|き} (machine, device). The word is paired symmetrically with {送信機|そうしんき} (transmitter). In everyday conversation about consumer electronics, Japanese speakers more often name the specific device — ラジオ (radio), テレビ, GPS, and so on — and reserve {受信機|じゅしんき} for technical discussion.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無線|むせん}{受信機|じゅしんき}: wireless receiver
- GPS {受信機|じゅしんき}: GPS receiver
- {衛星|えいせい}{受信機|じゅしんき}: satellite receiver
- {高性能|こうせいのう}の{受信機|じゅしんき}: high-performance receiver
- {受信機|じゅしんき}の{感度|かんど}: receiver sensitivity

RELATED WORDS:
- {送信機|そうしんき}: transmitter — the paired device that sends signals
- {受信|じゅしん}: reception (of a signal) — the action itself
- アンテナ: antenna — the component that picks up signals for the receiver
- チューナー: tuner — loanword; common in home-audio and TV contexts
